responsibility: Declares the derive expander specialized for builtin #[derive(Clone)]. The DeriveClone class extends the generic derive visitor interface with helpers that build clone calls, the fn clone(&self) -> Self method, and the surrounding Clone impl block, and it provides shape-specific visit hooks for structs, tuple structs, enums, and unions so macro expansion can synthesize Clone implementations as AST items.
same_name_distinction: Declares the DeriveClone specialization and its helper methods for building Clone-specific pieces such as clone_call, clone_fn, and clone_impl. Unlike the paired .cc, it defines the expander’s interface and override points, not the generated AST construction logic.
